user_reported_bug: I want the admin to use the light colour as the user backend on login. Also with the dark background, some text are hard to see as they are not white - I have attached screenshots. I want this to be fixed throughout the entire backend. I want a section where they can change this.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused admin-theme verification found the primary contrast/login fixes working, but the new Preferences theme controls are not synchronized with the top-bar theme toggle, so the theme-changing section is only partially fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: After choosing Light on /admin/preferences, the page switches immediately and localStorage is updated, but the top-bar Light button still has aria-pressed='false'. After choosing Dark from the top bar while on Preferences, the Preferences Dark radio still has aria-checked='false' and Light remains checked.

integration_issues.issue: AdminShell and AdminPreferences each keep independent theme state. localStorage/root data-theme update succeeds, but mounted controls do not stay in sync until navigation/remount.

action_items: Move admin theme state into a shared context/store (or pass AdminShell setter to Preferences) so both the top-bar segmented control and /admin/preferences radio group render from the same state.
Do not have AdminPreferences directly mutate .admin-root only; update the shared state and localStorage together, or dispatch/listen for a theme-change event while mounted.
Retest Preferences-to-topbar and topbar-to-Preferences sync after the change.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPreferences has its own useState initialized from localStorage and directly sets document.querySelector('.admin-root').setAttribute('data-theme', t), but AdminShell owns the top-bar theme state and is not updated by this action.
AdminShell writes localStorage when the top-bar toggle changes, but AdminPreferences does not observe that change while mounted, leaving its aria-checked state stale.
seed_data_creation: Created short-lived admin_sessions DB entries for hello@techglove.com.au to authenticate the admin UI without consuming MFA backup codes or changing TOTP setup. Temporary token file was deleted after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary symptoms passed: /admin/login renders light (root data-theme='light', contrast 14.3:1); /admin Overview h1 contrast 15.53:1; TOTAL USERS/MRR labels contrast 10.0:1; /admin/feature-flags h1 contrast 15.53:1; Preferences page exists; Light toggle applies immediately and persists across navigation; System follows emulated light/dark OS. Remaining failure: top-bar and Preferences controls do not stay in sync while mounted.
rca_of_the_issue: Repro: login as admin, open /admin/preferences, click Light. The admin root switches to light and localStorage['wayly.admin.theme']='light', but [data-testid='admin-theme-light'] remains aria-pressed='false'. Then click top-bar D; root/localStorage switch to dark, but [data-testid='prefs-theme-dark'] remains aria-checked='false' and Preferences still shows Light:true. Root cause is split theme state between AdminShell and AdminPreferences with local DOM/localStorage mutation instead of a shared state source. No APIs were MOCKED.
